notes: Primary spec data (video I/O, power rating, display specs) confirmed on TVLogic's own site (tvlogic.tv/New/M_Spec.asp?sidx=81) and cross-checked against TVLogic's own product brochure PDF (hosted by UK distributor thameside.tv), both agreeing: Input = 1x DVI-I, 1x BNC composite, 2x BNC 3G/HD/SD-SDI (A/B), 1x HDMI; Output = 1x BNC composite, 1x BNC 3G/HD/SD-SDI. Power: DC 12V (or 24V) / AC 100-240V 50/60Hz, 60W. Desktop unit with stand (445 x 264 x 78.4mm body); rack mount is an optional accessory, not native, so rackUnits omitted. Details for RS-422, LAN, Audio, USB, and the DC-input pinout (pins 1/2 GND, 3/4 +12/+24V) come from a third-party AI-generated extraction of the TVLogic operation manual hosted on ManualsLib (manualslib.com/manual/3843720/Tvlogic-Lvm-171a.html) — not one of the preferred authoritative sources, and its extraction was internally inconsistent (one pass omitted the DVI-I port that the manufacturer's own materials confirm exists), so treat those specific connector labels/types as medium-to-low confidence pending direct manual verification. B&H's product page (a preferred retailer source) returned HTTP 403 and could not be used; bis-tv.com's spec PDF failed TLS certificate verification and was not fetched per policy. No dedicated physical TALLY connector was found — tally appears to be controlled via the RS-422/LAN control ports rather than a discrete jack. HDMI and LAN bandwidth grades were not stated by the manufacturer and are therefore omitted rather than inferred.
